title: eval-harness: CI integration for per-prompt regression metrics (metrics hook + gating)
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add a CI-level integration that collects per-prompt evaluation metrics from eval-harness runs and publishes them into the metrics pipeline so we can (1) monitor prompt-level regressions over time and (2) enforce quality gating on PRs. This change implements a lightweight post-eval hook that serializes per-prompt metrics (accuracy, F1, BLEU/ROUGE depending on task) and sends them to the centralized ingest endpoint. It also adds a GitHub Actions job + a check runner that compares the latest metrics against the branch baseline and fails the job if any prompt falls below configured regression thresholds.

What this PR includes: checklist
- [x] eval-harness: new ci/hooks/prompt_metrics_hook.py that formats and uploads per-prompt metrics
- [x] .github/workflows/eval-metrics-ci.yml to run evals in CI and call the hook
- [x] tests: unit + integration test for the hook and the check comparator
- [x] docs: docs/eval-harness/ci.md describing configuration and thresholds
- [x] infra: small change to infra/metrics/ingest_lambda.py to accept eval_metrics namespace
- [x] e2e: example job in redwood-examples showing how to opt into gating

Design notes: the hook is intentionally idempotent and writes a single metrics payload per eval run to the ingest endpoint with tags (repo, pr, commit, model, prompt_set). The gating comparator reads the baseline metrics from the metrics store (time-windowed) and flags per-prompt regressions using configurable tolerances. We do not block merges automatically in this PR: the GitHub check fails the PR and requires maintainers to either fix the regression or override the check. Future iteration may add auto-rollback.

Security/ops: metrics are scrubbed for sensitive prompt content (only prompt identifiers and hashed prompt fingerprints are sent). Telemetry volume is limited by sampling large prompt-sets (configurable).

Testing: added unit tests for serializer and comparator, and an integration test that runs a small eval on a toy prompt-set and verifies the CI job uploads metrics and that the comparator flags an injected regression.

Related: ENG-8452 (eval metrics visibility), ENG-8520 (PR gating for prompt regressions).

release_notes: Add CI integration for per-prompt eval metrics: introduces a post-eval hook that uploads per-prompt metrics to the metrics pipeline and a GitHub Actions comparator that can block PRs on prompt-level regressions. Docs included for configuration and opt-out.
notes_for_oncall: If the comparator starts flagging many unrelated regressions, check sample-size config and ingestion latency; the hook retries are exponential backoff and will emit a metric in redwood.eval_harness.hook.errors.
